# AtmosVibe (atmosvibe.io)

> AtmosVibe is the Atmosphere Intelligence & OTA Photo Optimisation Platform for hotels, cruise lines, and travel brands. We turn property and local neighbourhood Vibe Signatures into higher OTA click-through rates and direct bookings.

## Core Capabilities
- **Free OTA Photo & Vibe Audit (`/audit`)**: Analyses live hotel OTA listings (e.g. Booking.com) and re-sequences the top 5 hero photos to align with local neighbourhood search demand, eliminating the "commodity bed penalty" in Slot #1.
- **5 Sensory Vibe Dimensions**: Classifies hospitality and local destination atmosphere across Sound (Acoustic Soul), People (The Social Mix), Colours & Materials (Visual Warmth), Energy (Day-to-Night Pulse), and Insider Tips (Gateway Secrets).
- **Gateway to Your Neighbourhood**: Connects properties, cruise port excursions, and tour operators with high-rated, authentic local subcultures across London, Barcelona, New York, Miami, Dubai, Tokyo, and global destinations.
